data:examples:0:name.text: Heishou (built around the Lord of Hongyuan)

data:examples:0:note.text: Build around the Lord of Hongyuan and Heishou Identities. Every Heishou has Rupture, but status damage is a bonus; the lineup relies on modern Identities' strength. The Lord's defense retreats a Heishou and brings a reserve Heishou out to use S3, so include reserve options such as Wei Branch, the 2 Si members, and the 2 You members. Deploy Cinq Assoc. West Section 3 Meursault, who attacks without reducing Rupture, and the near-essential Devyat' Assoc. North Section 3 Rodion.

data:examples:0:members:0:note.text: The core commander, granting Heishou extra actions and swapping them through defense. Extremely fragile.

data:examples:0:members:1:note.text: An essential, independently strong pick whose technique loop starts from Assist Defense.

data:examples:0:members:2:note.text: Strider【Wu】 supports clashes, while Linebreaker provides Shield and damage.

data:examples:0:members:3:note.text: Aims for at least 10 Speed and sustains Rupture Count through S1 reuse and S3.

data:examples:0:members:4:note.text: Outpaces enemies and deals damage through Rupture and Deathrite. Heishou Bolus Contamination adds Rupture Count on unopposed attacks.

data:examples:0:members:5:note.text: A Pierce attacker that hits without reducing the Rupture established by allies.

data:examples:0:members:6:note.text: Every 6 Rupture also increases Coin Power, enabling full strength early in Rupture teams.

data:examples:0:egos:0:note.text: When used by the Lord, negates death once and restores 60% HP.

data:examples:0:egos:2:note.text: An area attack that applies Rupture, Bleed, and Gluttony Fragility together.

data:examples:0:egos:3:note.text: Uses Gluttony Resonance to give all allies Poise and healing.

data:combos:0:name.text: Wu pair (Wu Branch Adept + Family Hierarch Candidate)

data:combos:0:note.text: Wu Branch Adept and Family Hierarch Candidate have particularly strong synergy. The Candidate gains Poise and Power alongside the Adept.

data:combos:0:members:0:note.text: At 5 Linebreaker, S3 becomes an area attack. Also coordinates with the Family Hierarch Candidate.

data:combos:0:members:1:note.text: Applies heavy Rupture against enemies she surpasses in Offense Level, then aims for heavy critical damage through S3.

data:flex:0:note.text: A Blunt Identity that deals more damage against enemies with high Rupture and Sinking. Can unleash enhanced S3 when brought out of standby through the Lord's coordination.

data:flex:1:note.text: A slow starter that builds Poise through Serpent Arm, then attacks with multi-Coin area S3.

data:flex:2:note.text: Builds Poise through Serpent Arm and strikes with a single-Coin S3. Coordination with the Lord grants Poise Count whenever Rupture deals damage.

data:flex:3:note.text: Builds Burn and Battleblood Instinct for enhanced S3. Self-inflicted Burn can easily consume opportunities for the Lord's swaps.

data:flex:4:note.text: Bloodflame [血炎] enables S2 reuse and Unbreakable Coins on S3. Gains 3 Bloodflame when leaving standby or returning.

data:flex:5:note.text: Applies heavy Rupture against enemies she surpasses in Offense Level, then builds Poise for heavy critical damage through S3.

data:flex:6:note.text: A follow-up each turn effectively grants 2 actions, while S3 and defense build Poise. Highly durable.

data:alternatives:0:note.text: A short-fight option that uses S3 early at 6 or more Speed to apply Fragile, letting allies acting later finish the enemy.

data:alternatives:1:note.text: An exceptional Rupture Count supplier that builds Tremor Count before applying heavy Rupture.

data:alternatives:2:note.text: A Rupture-focused W Corp. Identity that uses Charge to apply heavy Rupture Potency and Count.

data:alternatives:3:note.text: A Bleed and Rupture Identity that distributes Attack Power Up for reliable early clashes.

data:alternatives:4:note.text: S2 applies heavy Tremor, while S3's Rupture and 5 Fragile increase damage from allies acting later.

data:egos:0:note.text: Creates a self-damage time limit and delivers an area attack with 7 Attack Weight at the lethal moment. When used by the Lord, negates death once and restores 60% HP. Choose the timing carefully.

data:egos:2:note.text: An area attack that applies Rupture, Bleed, and Gluttony Fragility together, making subsequent attacks easier.

data:egos:3:note.text: Gives all allies Poise and heals every turn after use. Benefits from Gluttony Resonance.

data:egos:4:note.text: A Gluttony area attack that cuts through multiple enemies while healing the 2 lowest-HP allies.

data:egos:5:note.text: Its resource affinities match Mao Branch Adept perfectly. Availability is limited.

guide:0:0:0.text: Build around [The Lord of Hongyuan](persona:0613) Hong Lu and Heishou Identities, all of which have Rupture. Rupture damage is mainly a bonus; the team relies on the latest Heishou's strength and the Lord's extra actions.

guide:1:0:0.text: The Lord's S3 calls the S3 of an early-deployed Heishou for a three-hit sequence. Many Heishou S3s grant effects that enhance their skills, stabilizing the opening.

guide:1:0:1.text: The Lord restores 20 SP to an incoming reserve Heishou and has them use S3, up to 2 times per Identity per Encounter.

guide:1:0:2.text: At stage start, the Lord gains Leash-holder of All Heishou based on the number of Heishou, including reserves, increasing Speed, Offense Level, and Defense Level.

guide:1:0:3.text: Many members, such as [Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Adept](persona:0212), are strong alone. Adding just 1–2 Heishou to the Lord can provide basic functionality.

guide:2:0:0.text: Include Heishou among reserves. Early in battle, use the Lord's defense Heishou Keenclaw [黑獣利爪] to retreat a spent Heishou and have the incoming one use S3.

guide:2:0:1.text: Coordinating through the Lord's S3 grants Heishou Bolus Contamination, a permanent buff that differs by Heishou. Particularly attractive are the Rupture Count increase for [Heishou Pack - Mao Branch](persona:1112) Outis and Poise Count increase for [Heishou Pack - Si Branch](persona:1212) Gregor.

guide:2:0:2.text: [Heishou Pack - Wu Branch Adept](persona:0114) and [Family Hierarch Candidate](persona:0812) have particularly strong synergy.

guide:2:0:3.text: Outside Heishou, [Cinq Assoc. West Section 3](persona:0511) Meursault is strong. His Rupture application is modest, but against targets with at least 15 Potency and 3 Count, he attacks without reducing Count, maintaining allies' setup while dealing damage.

guide:2:0:4.text: [Devyat' Assoc. North Section 3](persona:0910) Rodion is near-essential: in addition to Courier Trunk, every 6 Rupture increases Coin Power, enabling full strength early. Retreat through defense if the battle drags on.

guide:3:0:0.text: Every Heishou has a Gluttony skill, making Gluttony-focused E.G.O compatible. Wrath is harder to generate.

guide:3:0:1.text: Healing options include [Fluid Sac](ego:0202), Sinclair's [Lantern](ego:1004), and [Thoracalgia](ego:0208), which benefits from Gluttony Resonance.

guide:3:0:2.text: Using [Tears of the Tarnished Blood [汚血泣淚]](ego:0608) with the Lord negates death once and restores 60% HP. Self-damage makes using it too early counterproductive.

guide:4:0:0.text: The Lord has extremely low HP. Heishou Keenclaw heals only 1 ally per turn, and Staggered Identities cannot retreat or heal through it. Prepare another healing option.

guide:4:0:1.text: The 2 You Branch members carry self-inflicted Burn and tend to consume opportunities for Heishou Keenclaw. Choose their use carefully unless the enemy is weak to Wrath.
